subject: math
title: Longer, Shorter, Taller
about: Ordering three things by length from words alone (a pencil is longer than a crayon, the crayon is longer than an eraser), comparing two things through a third one, and reading two measured objects to say which is longer, shorter or taller. NC.1.MD.1 asks for exactly this ordering and indirect comparison, and NC.1.MD.2 supplies the block counts.
tip: Ask him to say the order out loud, longest to shortest, before he picks.

cards.q: A pencil is longer than a crayon. A crayon is longer than an eraser. Which is longest?
A rope is shorter than a scarf. A scarf is shorter than a hose. Which is shortest?
A tree is taller than a house. The house is taller than a flower. Which is tallest?
A giraffe is taller than a horse. The horse is taller than a dog. Which is shortest?
A train is longer than a truck. The truck is longer than a bike. Which is in the middle?
A ladder is taller than a chair. The chair is taller than a cup. Which is in the middle?
A string is as long as a pencil. The pencil is longer than a crayon. Which is longer, string or crayon?
A ribbon is as long as a stick. The stick is shorter than a rope. Which is shorter, the ribbon or the rope?
A desk is longer than a string. A book is shorter than that string. Which is longer, the desk or the book?
A door is taller than a stick. A box is shorter than that stick. Which is taller, the door or the box?
The cucumber is 5 blocks long. A banana is 7 blocks long. Which is longer?
The broom is 10 blocks long. A guitar is 8 blocks long. Which is shorter?
The bone is 3 blocks long. A corn cob is 4 blocks long. Which is shorter?
The crocodile is 11 blocks long. A canoe is 9 blocks long. Which is longer?
The boat is 6 blocks long. A sock is 6 blocks long. Which is longer?
A sock is 6 blocks, a guitar is 8 blocks and a bone is 3 blocks. Which is longest?
A canoe is 9 blocks, a corn cob is 4 blocks and a broom is 10 blocks. Which is shortest?
You want to see which stick is longer. Where do you line up the sticks?
